diagnosis: trigger_periodic_task_now allows forcing immediate execution of background periodic tasks by setting one_off=True and enabled=True. Because it looks up PeriodicTask by task_id without checking whether the task belongs to request.user.customer_account, an authenticated user can trigger intensive ETL pipelines, billable webhooks, or automated actions belonging to competitor accounts.
